# Project identity

- `rds-logo.svg` preserves the three orange, gray and black paths from the user-supplied Penrose triangle artwork.
- `rds-hero-light.svg` and `rds-hero-dark.svg` pair that mark with the full project name. The dark version uses an ivory face for contrast.

All three files contain native vector paths, with no raster images, remote resources or font dependencies. The Illustrator source remains with its owner; empty layers and editing metadata are omitted from these web assets.
